subject: 荆州城墙 · 东门寅宾门城台与宾阳楼正面（自城外东侧）
name: 荆州城墙
era: 清 · 1646年重建城垣 · 1987年复建城楼
yearNote: 年表取现存城垣的清顺治三年（1646）重建；东门寅宾门上的宾阳楼明代始建、清咸丰十一年（1861）重建后毁，现楼为1986–1987年由国家文物保护科研所设计按明代形制重建，非古构。
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q137459112（宾阳楼 Binyang Tower）P625 坐标 30.350155, 112.210209，东门城楼近似坐标，非本项目测绘；地图显示点新建 hb_jingzhou。
lede: 荆州古城墙是南方保存最完整的古城墙之一，自西汉的土城一路用到今天。现存砖城为清顺治三年（1646）重建，周长11.8公里，东门名寅宾门。门上的宾阳楼1987年依明代形制重建，灰砖城台托着红柱重檐的城楼，是荆州古城最常见的一幅画面。
facts: 现存城垣清顺治三年（1646）重建，东西长3.75公里、南北宽1.2公里，周长11.821公里；城墙高8.83米，顶宽3至5米，有城垛4567个、炮台26座。
东门寅宾门为券拱门洞，城台东西宽12.65米、南北长34米；门上宾阳楼明代始建，清咸丰十一年（1861）重建后又毁，现楼1986年设计、1987年落成。
宾阳楼重檐歇山、大木构架，通高12.9米，面阔18.9米、进深11.6米，36根木柱支撑，上层设露明回廊；城墙1996年列第四批全国重点文物保护单位。
caption: 荆州城墙 · 寅宾门与宾阳楼
清 · 1646年重建城垣
structure_checkpoints: 城台：灰色条砖砌筑，略有收分，顶部一排雉堞（垛口）贯通全幅；正中一座半圆券门洞，券顶上方嵌一块横长石门额（线稿留空白牌位）；门洞内可见一扇钉饰木门；城台两侧城墙向左右延伸到画幅外。
城楼：两层、重檐歇山。下层为开敞柱廊，一排纤细红柱（主图可数约七至八个开间，以照片为准，不得减为三间或五间），柱间原悬红灯笼（去除）；柱上额枋绘青绿彩画，其上出下檐，檐角起翘。
上层：四周绕平座，深红木栏杆；殿身为红色格扇门窗，正中悬横匾（留白）；上檐歇山顶，正脊两端鸱吻、垂脊有走兽，灰筒瓦；上檐宽度略小于下檐。
画面去除：左侧蓝色座椅看台、右侧金色花车道具、门洞内行人与汽车、墙面上的三个大字、墙头藤蔓；只保留城台一段、门洞与城楼。
material_observations: 城台与城墙为青灰色条砖，砖缝灰白；城楼木构朱红色（柱、栏杆、格扇），额枋青绿彩画间夹金色回纹带，屋面青灰色筒瓦，脊饰灰黑；石门额深灰；地面灰色石板与碎石。
author: Fxqf

source_note: 主图为 Fxqf 2017年8月自城外东侧正对寅宾门拍摄，城台、门洞、两层城楼完整；补充图为 Popolon 2010年自城内侧拍摄的城楼，用于核对屋顶与平座。线稿去除看台、道具、灯笼、人物与墙面大字。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the East Gate (Yinbin Gate) of the Jingzhou city wall with its gate tower Binyang Lou, seen straight-on from outside the wall (Image 2); Image 3 is a view from inside the city for the roof and balcony only. Draw a long horizontal segment of grey brick city wall with a continuous row of crenellated merlons along the top, a single semicircular arched gateway at the centre with a blank rectangular stone tablet above the arch, and the two-storey tower standing on the wall directly above the gate. Lower storey of the tower: an open colonnade of slender columns across its full width—reproduce the number of columns and openings seen in Image 2 (about seven to eight narrow openings), with a lower hip-and-gable eave whose corners curl up. Upper storey: a surrounding balcony with railing, lattice doors, a blank horizontal plaque at the centre, and a hip-and-gable top roof with ridge-end ornaments; the top roof is slightly narrower than the lower eave. Omit the lanterns, the three large characters on the wall, the bleacher seats at left, the carriage prop at right, people, cars and vines. Keep the wall ends cut cleanly at the canvas margins.
Orientation: landscape 1536×1024.
